notes:
SUMMARY: Mid-market product org building semantic search + in-app assistant for EU customers. Started on Hosted API to move quickly; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable costs and EU residency guarantees.

POC / TECH: Hosted pilot Jan-Feb 2026. Pilot used gpt-style open models for embeddings + a chat flow. Works functionally; observed p95 latency spikes ~300-450ms for users in DE/FR during peak versus target p95 < 200ms. Team wants Dedicated nodes in eu-central-1 and a multi-region routing policy: prefer eu-only for EU accounts, fallback to other regions only under capacity or explicit consent. Testing plan: Dedicated POC w/ small reserved pool week of 2026-03-15; performance tests scheduled 2026-03-20 (latency, KV cache hit rates, batching tradeoffs).

SECURITY/COMPLIANCE: Strong EU data residency requirement: "can't risk any customer data leaving EU" (CTO paraphrase). Need legal appendix that guarantees processing + storage within EU and audit logs retained 12 months. SSO/SAML already required; SOC2 certification must be documented. KMS integration desirable for key control.

BUSINESS/PRICING: Mid-market budget but cost-sensitive; prefer hosted for dev but willing to commit to 12mo Dedicated if unit economics show 30-40% cost reduction vs hosted at projected scale. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization/ batching) before committing. Finance asked for three pricing bands: reserved 12mo, reserved 36mo, and on-demand burst.

CONSTRAINTS & RISKS: Legal signoff on EU-only processing is the biggest blocker. Also concerned about multi-region routing causing higher tail latency if fallback to non-EU. They want to see dedicated eu-central-1 benchmarks with realistic traffic (embeddings throughput ~120 reqs/s, chat p95 target <200ms).

QUOTES / FROM CALLS: "We need a clean line: EU data stays in EU unless we explicitly opt-in" — CTO. "If Dedicated brings 30% cost savings and 2x better p95 we can commit" — Head of Product.

NEXT STEPS: Deliver Dedicated POC plan + eu-central-1 perf benchmark by 2026-03-12; update proposal with 12mo pricing and EU residency appendix; schedule legal Q&A with Redwood security team.
